title: Spillage reported up the chain, told to go away, file deleted

tellings.quote: he basically recommended to me, delete that and pretend he never saw it, and then he just left the room.

plain: In 2018, a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says he came across secret material about unexplained objects sitting where it did not belong, which insiders call a "spillage". He reported it to a superior in the Pentagon office that oversees its most secret programs, and he says the man "basically recommended to me, delete that and pretend he never saw it, and then he just left the room." Brown tells this from his own experience and ties it to a document he calls the Immaculate Constellation capabilities briefing. If true, it would mean officials were quietly burying such reports rather than passing them on.
